english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for saying that a man or boy is handsome.
Use this specifically when describing a good-looking male, especially in casual speech.

examples.jyutping: nei5 go3 zai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 zai2 wo3

examples.english: That new colleague is pretty good-looking.
examples.jyutping: go2 go3 san1 tung4 si6 gei2 leng3 zai2 wo3
